Morning team —

We need a tight reconciliation for EMEA/APAC ahead of finance lock. Please: 

- Confirm committed ARR (net of expected churn) for accounts in the Q2 lockpack by 12:00 CET today.
- Flag any outliers where CRO/AE are pushing a commit but procurement/legal risk exists — include brief reason and expected close date.
- Use the attached commit-rollup-template.xlsx and drop in the shared Drive folder linked below.

Initial list I've pulled from HubSpot (please verify): NordicTel (SE), PacificOps (SG), RidgeManufacturing (DE), BlueHarbor (UK).

Ask: If anyone wants to push an exception to finance (discount, SLA credit, extended payment terms), note that in the Exception column and tag finance@redwood.ai. Finance will triage.

Link to drive: https://drive.redwood/shared/Q2-commit-rollups/EMEA-APAC
Attachment: commit-rollup-template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — this one is high priority for the close plan.

Monica Patel
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

I'll monitor and update. If we can't get finance decision by 12:00 CET I'll move NordicTel to "Next Quarter" to keep forecast conservative.
